  Exam Date & Time: 06-May-2024 (02:30 PM - 05:30 PM)  
  
  
  MANIPAL ACADEMY OF HIGHER EDUCATION  
  MIT BLR - BTech VI Semester - End Semester Examination - April / May -2024  
  AI for Medical Image Analysis [CSE-4011]  
  Marks: 50                                                                               Duration: 180 mins.  
  PART-A  
  Answer all the questions.  
  1)           With appropriate examples, compare and contrast the various segmentation strategies  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Relate how space and time continuity contribute to the task of image segmentation          (3)  
  C)      Predict whether the following statement is true or false and justify your answer.  
  "Segmentation in a noisy environment is difficult than it seems".                          (2)  
  
  2)           Investigate the operational mechanics of the Scale Invariant Feature Transform  
  algorithm, elaborating on its underlying principles.  
  (5)  
  A)  
  B)      Demonstrate the significance of Laplacian of Gaussian in Blob detection task with  
  example.                                                                                   (3)  
  
  C)      Compare and contrast multiresolution edge detection and multi-resolution edge tracking  
  with examples.                                                                         (2)  
  
  3)           Compare and contrast TensorFlow, Caffe, and Theano deep learning frameworks in  
  terms of their suitability for medical image analysis tasks. What are the key features,  
  advantages, and limitations of each framework, particularly in handling large-scale        (5)  
  A)      medical image datasets?  
  
  B)      Relate the capabilities of MATLAB 2020b for medical image processing and analysis.         (3)  
  C)  
  
  
  (2)

  4)              A radiology department in a hospital is overwhelmed with the manual segmentation of  
  organs from CT scans for treatment planning in radiation therapy. They seek to  
  implement an automated segmentation solution to streamline the process and improve  
  A)         efficiency. With the provided scenario in mind, determine a detailed strategy for         (5)  
  developing and deploying an automated organ segmentation algorithm for CT scans in  
  the context of radiation therapy treatment planning.  
  
  B)         For the scenario given below, determine the preprocessing steps necessary to standardize  
  image intensities, correct imaging artifacts, and normalize spatial dimensions across the  
  dataset.  
  A radiology department in a hospital is overwhelmed with the manual segmentation of (3)  
  organs from CT scans for treatment planning in radiation therapy. They seek to  
  implement an automated segmentation solution to streamline the process and improve  
  efficiency.  
  
  C)         For the scenario given below, determine how would you validate the developed system.  
  
  A radiology department in a hospital is overwhelmed with the manual segmentation of  
  organs from CT scans for treatment planning in radiation therapy. They seek to            (2)  
  implement an automated segmentation solution to streamline the process and improve  
  efficiency.  
  
  5)              Contrast a difference between analysis tasks for a clinical study compared to image  
  analysis in computer-assisted surgery and name at least two analysis tasks that could  
  arise when using images for diagnosis support. Infer the main problem that arises when    (5)  
  A)         validating an analysis method.  
  
  B)         Contrast the difference between an HIS and an RIS. Why is it useful to have several  
  different information systems in a hospital?                                              (3)  
  
  C)         Explain the structure of a DICOM file. What are the general components and how is the  
  structure of a tagged information entity in the file?                                 (2)  
  
  
  -----End-----
